column1: # Probes run in every running container (via docker exec, no shell) and on the host.
# They catch software built from source that the Trivy DB cannot see.
# Columns (TAB separated):  name  version_cmd  fixed_versions  cves  exposure_cmd  exposure_regex  note
#   fixed_versions: comma list, one per branch; vulnerable = below the fix of its own major.minor branch,
#                   or (branch without fix) below the newest fix. "-" = info only, just log the version.
#   exposure_cmd/regex: optional extra condition that makes the bug reachable ("-" = none).
